# OneHaat
> Hyperlocal haat and grocery delivery platform connecting consumers to verified neighborhood grocers, authentic spice mills, and daily haats with zero dark-store markup and 9-minute 59-second average delivery.

## Platform Summary
- Platform Name: OneHaat
- Legal Entity: OneHaat Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- Official Website: https://[YOURDOMAIN.com]
- Primary Operating Region: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Average Delivery Time: 9 minutes 59 seconds
- Merchant Listing Commission: 0% (zero listing cuts for local shopkeepers)
- Pricing Guarantee: 100% price parity with printed GST store bill inside every tote bag
- Support Email: access.onehaat@gmail.com

## Core Value Pillars
- Direct Store Shelves: Goods are hand-packed by generational family grocers from physical shelves, not artificial suburban refrigerated warehouses.
- Counter-Shelf Pricing: Transparent pricing matching what neighborhood walk-in customers pay.
- Zero Dark Stores: Preserving neighborhood businesses and local economic vitality.
- FSSAI Certified: Fully certified and compliant with food safety regulations.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Q: How does OneHaat deliver in 9 minutes 59 seconds without cold dark stores?
  A: OneHaat connects shoppers only to verified neighborhood shops within a 2.5 km colony radius. The shopkeeper hand-packs immediately and local riders deliver in 9m 59s.
- Q: Are product prices marked up?
  A: Never. 100% price parity with printed GST retail bill included.
- Q: What does OneHaat charge merchants?
  A: 0% listing commission on counter sales. Merchants retain 100% of their retail margin.
